# devopser_workspace (Data Source)

Looks up a workspace by name (tfe_workspace).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "devopser_workspace" "network" {
  name = "network"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Workspace name.

### Optional

- `organization` (String) Accepted for tfe compatibility and ignored.

### Read-Only

- `auto_apply` (Boolean) Whether plans apply without a confirmation.
- `id` (String) The workspace id.
- `terraform_version` (String) The workspace's OpenTofu version.
- `working_directory` (String) Directory in the repository that runs execute in.
